2025_128_dec_2024_pcard_report.page:
**Document type and period**
Procurement-card (PCARD) transaction register for Troy School District, titled "TROY SCHOOL DISTRICT, PCARD report, Dec 2024." The listing runs 29 numbered pages, each carrying the footer date 2/20/2025, and appears on the Board of Education agenda dated February 25, 2025. Individual transaction dates range from 11/26/2024 to 12/26/2024. There is no narrative, resolution, recommendation, or signature block — the document is entirely a line-item register.

**Report format**
Each page repeats the same headings: Transaction Description, JE Description, Budget Unit, A/C Code, Transaction Amount, Credits. Transaction Description concatenates the posting date with a truncated merchant name (for example, "12/16/2024-NINO SALVAGG"). Budget units are fifteen-digit strings whose leading three digits vary across 101, 120, 122, 423, 520, 529, 530, 531, 700 and 701. Account codes observed include 3120, 3180, 3190, 3210, 3220, 3311, 3410, 3430, 3450, 3510, 4120, 4220, 4910, 5000, 5110, 5310, 5410, 5710, 5910, 5990, 6410, 7410, 7910 and 7919. Rows post either a Transaction Amount or a Credit; the unused column prints a dash.

2025_128_dec_2024_pcard_report.verbose:
**Identification**
"TROY SCHOOL DISTRICT, PCARD report, Dec 2024" is a procurement-card transaction register produced for the Troy School District Board of Education and appearing on the agenda for the meeting of February 25, 2025. The register runs 29 numbered pages; each page footer prints the page number followed by the date 2/20/2025, and each page repeats the report title and the column header row: Transaction Description, JE Description, Budget Unit, A/C Code, Transaction Amount, Credits. All rows share the journal-entry description "DEC 2024 PCARD EXP." Posting dates on individual lines run from 11/26/2024 through 12/26/2024, so the cycle spans the tail of November and nearly all of December 2024. One line prints an out-of-range date as "11/26/2025-CORPORATE AN" ($3.00, budget unit 101668252024500, account 3190); three otherwise identical Corporate An charges of $3.00 are dated 11/26/2024. The document contains no narrative, no vote, no contract award language and no signature.

**Stated totals**
The final two lines of the register report a Subtotal of $261,732.02 in the Transaction Amount column and $18,512.17 in the Credits column, followed by Total Expenses of $243,219.85.

**Coding structure**
Budget units are fifteen-digit strings. Leading segments observed include 101 (by far the most common), 120, 122, 423, 520, 529, 530, 531, 700 and 701. Account codes observed are 3120, 3180, 3190, 3210, 3220, 3311, 3410, 3430, 3450, 3510, 4120, 4220, 4910, 5000, 5110, 5310, 5410, 5710, 5910, 5990, 6410, 7410, 7910 and 7919. Account 5000 dominates the 700/701 budget units, 5110 dominates the 101 instructional units, and 5990 carries much of the operations and maintenance activity.

The single largest charge is The Home Depot at $9,868.55 on 12/23/2024 (531004118620200, account 6410).
